environment.description: Same IoT gateway service deployed on a Kubernetes pod with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The pod spec includes a localhost seccomp profile reference (seccompProfile type: Localhost, localhostProfile: 'profiles/iot-device-handler-restricted.json') which is a custom-authored profile derived from the container's strace output during normal operation. The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode (not log-only) and the allowlist was generated via 'oci-seccomp-bpf-hook' during a 72-hour burn-in period where only legitimate telemetry and firmware-check flows were exercised. The resulting profile permits read/write/openat/close/fstat/mmap/mprotect/brk/futex/clone3/epoll_wait/accept4 and 47 other syscalls observed during normal gRPC serving, but notably does NOT include execve/execveat/fork/vfork/clone(with CLONE_THREAD only permitted)/ptrace/socket(AF_INET creation is allowed but only via the pre-opened listening socket inherited from the runtime - new socket() calls for outbound connections are filtered by argument). The profile was validated with 'scmp_bpf_sim' against the specific exploit payload pattern. Container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) with no added capabilities and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true.
